$comment: Synthetic PII test set for pii-gateway.mts. Every value is fictional: example.com/.org/.net emails, 555-01xx and Ofcom drama-range phone numbers, SSNs from the 987-65-432x advertising range, published test card numbers and example IBANs. Never add real personal data to this file. Each document lists exactly five PII items (pii) and two non-PII phrases that must survive redaction (keep). variants are other spellings of the same item that must also be removed.
